regime_context: Canada TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the leading theme with full breadth and mixed durability, though crowded. The absolute-trend gate—the only validated edge for drawdown control—is in effect, keeping non-eligible themes like Gold Miners and Technology unfavourable. Rotation is broad, with no one-narrative dominance or confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The Big Banks theme is the current leader with eligibility (trend gate passed), full breadth, and a moderate durability bar of 0.72. While the theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.2), the absolute-trend discipline supports staying with the trend for drawdown control, not a return forecast. Crowding cautions sizing but does not warrant fading.
evidence: Headline theme with rank 1 and eligibility true
Durability bar 0.72 (mixed Hurst but broad participation)
Absolute-trend gate validated for risk control (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: The momentum rank itself has no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0), and crowding often coincides with sharp reversals; the theme could mean-revert if macro conditions shift.

falsifier.text: If the Big Banks theme loses trend-gate eligibility (i.e., ZEB.TO falls below its absolute-trend threshold) or if durability collapses below 0.5 and breadth declines.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are ineligible (trend gate breached), signalling a sustained downtrend or choppy price action. The absolute-trend discipline, the only validated edge, prescribes avoiding such themes to limit drawdowns. The durability bar is low (0.33) and breadth poor (0.25), reinforcing the risk.
evidence: Eligible is false; rank 10 and score negative
Durability bar 0.33, Hurst trend but weak breadth
Absolute-trend gate is the validated risk-control mechanism (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: In a sudden precious metals rally, the trend gate could flip back to eligible; the detector would then permit re-entry, and avoiding it now misses potential upside.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners regain eligibility (trend gate turns bullish) and durability bar rises above 0.5 with improving breadth.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is eligible with a decent durability bar (0.65), high breadth (0.85), and is not crowded. As a defensive yield theme, its trend-following signal aligns with the absolute-trend discipline, offering lower-volatility exposure without the reflexivity risk of crowded leaders.
evidence: Rank 7 positive score, but momentum rank is only a focus lens
theses.dissent: The theme ranks low and has no strong absolute momentum; if interest rate or macro shifts reduce demand for yield plays, its trend could break and durability may drop.

falsifier.text: If Utilities loses trend-gate eligibility or if durability bar falls below 0.5 and breadth narrows below 0.7.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
